experience.description: Develop and maintain production software across billing, customer lifecycle automation, monitoring and infrastructure management, working on both backend systems and user-facing applications.
responsibilities: Redesigned and re-architected the company's online store and subscription flows, expanding support for recurring products and new products and services integrated with the Stripe API.
Reworked the checkout architecture and state machine while redesigning the store interface to support more complex billing and subscription scenarios.

Designed and implemented a customer lifecycle email automation system with configurable delivery rules based on subscription state, customer type, time until expiration and time spent in a given state, with customizable email templates managed through the administration panel.

Built an internal administration platform using Next.js and Express for managing an email hosting service, including domains, mailboxes, aliases, bulk account creation, storage quotas, account limits and permissions.
Developed a customizable interactive map representing the hierarchy of registered devices, supporting drag-and-drop positioning, monitoring widgets and configurable visual appearance.

experience.description: Provided specialized technical support for Linux-based production environments, including server administration, network troubleshooting, firewall configuration and monitoring automation.
responsibilities: Provided specialized remote support for Monsta software, including installation, configuration and maintenance on Linux servers.
Configured and maintained Linux server infrastructure, managing services, network ports and firewall rules.
Analyzed application and system logs to diagnose production issues, troubleshoot failures and resolve incidents.
Investigated network connectivity and traffic issues using tools such as tcpdump and netstat.
Developed and maintained Lua-based automation and monitoring scripts used to track customer services and system health.
